Q: Is there an android shell or adb command that I could use to get a device's IMEI/MEID? A:

For Android 11-16:

adb shell service call iphonesubinfo 10 i32 <sub> s16 com.android.shell s16 com.android.shell
  • 10 is the method ID for getSubscriberIdForSubscriber in IPhoneSubInfo.aidl
  • <sub> is the subscription ID (get it from adb shell dumpsys isub)
